title: "04 · Paths, trees and flows"

  enabled: false

Shortest paths, minimum spanning trees, maximum flow and minimum cut, with every
claim checked against an answer worked out independently.

The generic algorithm operators **never read an edge weight**. There is no field
for one to travel in, so every weighted branch is guarded by a test that is
always false and every edge is worth 1.0. Shortest path reports a hop count as a
distance, and deleting the weights from the mesh changes nothing; max-flow and
min-cut return 3 = 3 where the answer is 19 = 19.

It also solves a problem the whole suite shares: showing a *subset* (a path, a
tree, a cut) when color cannot carry membership, because an edge attribute is
averaged onto the vertices and a two-valued flag lands on the two darkest ends
of the ramp. Letting geometry carry membership and color carry magnitude is
worth 90 levels of separation for a path, against −15 for the obvious approach.
